title: How tied is the mall world to real geography (where are you located?) ?
content: I read about the mall world yesterday and watched L.Love’s video before sleeping, wondering perhaps if I would visit it right away. Well, I did not, my recurring location has always been the town I was born in (Tampere, Finland), and I woke up from a dream that happened there again - or rather the basic layout of my DreamCity is based on my home town, twisted of course in many ways, but when I know I’m there I can always navigate, based on my knowledge about the general directions and basic landmarks, like river rapids or the central market square, from where I woke up today. The thing is I have not lived in my birth town for years, now spending over 20 years in the capital, so I have lived in Helsinki bigger part of my life than in other places. Sometimes parts of it appear in my dreams, but I’d say those parts only meld to the basic structure that I often find myself in, and that is based on the dream version of my hometown. Bit similar are those DreamHouse dreams where the basic structure of a house in dream has most often been either my childhood house, or the one where my granparents lived. I’ve had lots of different types of dreams, many strange and often quite lucid, and I keep journal and love to hear about people’s dreams, so this mall world was fascinating idea to me. I’ve tried triggering shared location with some people before, so that’s not a new idea to me. I’ve had few odd "travel" dreams when waking up I felt I had been to some other parts of the world (where I’ve never been) and I could verify from maps that the locations were actual places. The feeling i got from mall world descriptions, was that it was, in a way, very American. So my mind went to theorizing: does mall world dreams happen only in dreams of people from USA (and maybe Canada and Mexico as well…)? Is it a North American thing, is the collective dreaming on that continent somehow fused together to form the mall world? Is it because historically US is relatively young country, built and grown up quite fast, and people moving in from different nationalities, the mall and those other modernish but shared landscapes melding into one...? So my question is, where you mall world dreamers are located? People in other countries and continents, do you also visit this same dream place? Is the phenomena global? I’d love to hear any other theories
